case_title: Sunita Patel vs. State of Maharashtra
facts: Allegations of misappropriation of society funds. Complainant and key witnesses failed to appear despite multiple summons for cross-examination.
Accused found in possession of stolen electronic goods. Charge-sheet filed. Multiple adjournments sought due to defense advocate indisposition.
Forged property documents presented for bank loan clearance. Co-accused granted bail; parity argument raised before the Bench.
Data exfiltration and unauthorized access into banking portal. Procedural delays in obtaining certificate under Section 65B of Evidence Act.
